# Temperature converter

## Scope
Build a small browser-based temperature converter. This is a single Node.js 22 application, not a microservice application. No database, identity service, message queue, Docker, OpenAPI specification or cloud deployment is required. Deliver package.json, source files, real unit tests,

# Temperature converter views

```plantuml
@startuml
actor User
component "Browser page" as UI
component "HTTP application" as HTTP
component "Pure temperature conversion" as Convert
User --> UI : enter temperature and units
UI --> HTTP : POST /api/convert
HTTP --> Convert : validate and convert
Convert --> HTTP : nume
